description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to WebAuthn ceremonies, including credential specifications, request and response structures, and verification data used in WebAuthn authentication flows.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialRpEntity
classes.description: Represents the relying party entity in credential creation.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialUserEntity
classes.description: Represents the user entity involved in credential creation.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialParameters
classes.description: Specifies the public key credential parameters, including type and algorithm.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialDescriptor
classes.description: Describes a specific credential, including type, id, and transports.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.AuthenticatorSelectionCriteria
classes.description: Defines criteria for selecting authenticators during registration.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions
classes.description: Options for creating a new credential, including challenge, relying party, user, parameters, and extensions.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions
classes.description: Options for requesting credential authentication, including challenge, rpId, and allowable credentials.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.AttestationResponse
classes.description: Response object from the authenticator during registration, containing client data and attestation object.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.RegistrationVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request to verify registration, including user info, challenge ID, and attestation response.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.AssertionResponse
classes.description: Response object from the authenticator during authentication, including client data, authenticator data, signature, user handle, and credential ID.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.AuthenticationVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request to verify authentication assertion, including username/email, challenge ID, and assertion response.

classes.name: WebAuthnDtos.TokenResponse
classes.description: Response containing the authentication token, its type, and expiry information.
